desc:
📦 Open a box. Get lucky. Become a legend. 🤑

🎈 AIRSHIP ALERT! It flies over the map and rains down boxes and mystery packages... Your move!

⚔️ Run, slap, dodge: fight for every box! The fastest grabs it all, the others just watch 😤

🎁 Every box can hide a treasure: from a simple apple all the way to Cosmic planets 🪐
🌈 Golden, Lava, Rainbow... one mutation and your find is worth a fortune
📖 Collect them all and complete your Index 100%
😎 Show off your rarest find and leave the whole game speechless!

💰 Sell your loot, boost your luck, conquer new worlds 🌋 and climb to the top of the leaderboard 🏆

❓ Did you know... the rarest item is a 1 in 4 BILLION chance 👀
Nobody has found it yet. What if it's you?

🎁 CODE: CARTONS

👍 LIKE & FAVORITE to unlock the next updates!
